## Overview

This project was **developed by [Mohamad Yassine](https://github.com/mohamadysn)**.

Repository: [https://github.com/mohamadysn/FaceGate](https://github.com/mohamadysn/FaceGate)

It provides a **cross-platform desktop application** and CLIs for:

1. **Enrolling** people (camera NEAR/FAR or photo albums)
2. **Recognizing** them live or on still images
3. Optionally tracking **pupils** and **gaze**, plus session **metrics**

Stack: Python · OpenCV · InsightFace · Tkinter · Quarto docs.

## Architecture (high level)

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  Cam[Webcam / photos] --> App[Desktop app / CLI]
  App --> Det[Face detect]
  Det --> Emb[Embeddings]
  Emb --> Gal[(Gallery JSON + NPY)]
  Emb --> Match[Cosine match]
  Match --> UI[Identity overlay]
  Det --> Pupil[Pupil / gaze optional]
```

## License & privacy

The on-disk gallery stores **embeddings only** (no face photos). Do not commit personal `gallery.json` / `embeddings.npy` files.
